data: NVIDIA delivered an exceptional fiscal 2024. Revenue reached $60.9 billion, up from $27.0 billion in fiscal 2023, a gain of 125.9%. Profitability rose even faster: net income climbed to $29.8 billion in fiscal 2024 from $4.4 billion in fiscal 2023, an increase of 581.3%, which points to substantial operating leverage as demand scaled. Cash generation kept pace with earnings, with operating cash flow of $28.1 billion in fiscal 2024 against $5.6 billion in fiscal 2023. The balance sheet strengthened as well. Total assets grew to $65.7 billion in fiscal 2024 from $41.2 billion in fiscal 2023, while total liabilities rose more modestly to $22.8 billion from $19.1 billion. Cash and cash equivalents more than doubled to $7.3 billion in fiscal 2024 from $3.4 billion in fiscal 2023, leaving the company well funded to sustain its growth.
